fun plan(contextPath: String): Evidence {
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val gather = parseGather(taskContext)
    val scope = readScope(gather)
    val verdict = readVerdict(gather)
    val findings = gradeFindings(gather)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(scope, verdict, findings)
    val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidence)
    val completion = emitNoop(message = "Plan-implements-spec judge evidence written with no graded findings because gather reported no spec_to_plan or plan_to_spec cells.")
    return evidence
}
